documentType: Independent actual orbital definition countercheck and exact bilingual correction
currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Orbitale als mögliche Lösungen der Wellenfunktion von Elektronen beschreiben und das Betragsquadrat der Wellenfunktion als Wahrscheinlichkeitsdichte für Aufenthaltsbereiche deuten.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can describe orbitals as possible solutions of the electron wave function and interpret the squared magnitude of the wave function as a probability density for regions of electron presence.
proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Orbitale als Ein-Elektronen-Wellenfunktionen beschreiben und das Betragsquadrat der Wellenfunktion als Wahrscheinlichkeitsdichte für Aufenthaltsbereiche deuten.
proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can describe orbitals as one-electron wavefunctions and interpret the squared magnitude of the wavefunction as a probability density for regions of electron presence.

primaryTerms.definitionExcerpt: One-electron wavefunction obtained as a solution of the Schrödinger equation for an atom.
Wavefunction depending explicitly on the spatial coordinates of only one electron.
The solution of the Schrödinger equation, eigenfunction of the hamiltonian operator.

actualSourceAccess: IUPAC primary pages returned definitions through web search indexing, independently read again 2026-10-07. Earlier direct web open of plain endpoints returned 403; no live HTTP200 or full freshly fetched page is claimed.
scientificReason: A wavefunction is a function/solution of the relevant Schrödinger equation. An orbital is a one-electron wavefunction, not a solution of an electron wavefunction. The literal curricular phrase remains historical source evidence and does not supersede subject correctness.
unchangedImage: Actual native plotted wavefunction/probability-density image remains didactically suitable; no new image required by this wording defect.
positiveCaseScope: Actual author-v2 cases already distinguish wavefunction/density, phase, nodes and density versus region probability. This D review does not grant native P approval; new goal/page/context/material fingerprints must be checked after correction.
futureAction: New targeted bilingual author version plus actual native one-goal D followup and targeted affected P/A/M bindings; unchanged other goals are not reviewed again.
